entities.name: Borys Grinchenko Kyiv Metropolitan University
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Borys Grinchenko Kyiv Metropolitan University is a higher education institution. The university was established by Kyiv municipal council through reorganization of Kyiv regional Teachers Training Institute named after Borys Hrinchenko. The university is communal property.
